xBRIEFInfo.description: Bound remedy from the #3983/#3984 set-level design-critique arc: matcher coverage so a denied Write cannot be reissued through the host shell, plus in-flight elapsed evaluation on the existing delivery-attempt ledger. Not the #3983 issue body.

plan.title: Close the PreToolUse shell reissue hole and evaluate elapsed on an in-flight delivery attempt

narratives.Description: One item, two parts. Part 1 (security, leads): the PreToolUse write gate matcher list is literal tool names and misses Grok Build run_terminal_command, so a Write denied by occupancy/ritual/scope can be reissued through the shell. Authorize every recognized in-repo mutation target the way #3614 did for ApplyPatch; do not occupancy-deny git status, occupancy:release, or OS-temp body-file writes. Part 2: the delivery-attempt ledger already evaluates elapsed before dispatch; extend it to a run already in flight. Turn duration was the only measured separator. Do not build a chokepoint that reads host memory logs, and do not build a parent-is-implementing detector.
narratives.Origin: Bound by #3983 arc: critics 5470935977, 5470940506, 5470981553; lean 5470992415; claims 5470996824; synthesis 5470998520. Defect record for part 1 is #3987.
narratives.Overview: Build the bound remedy, not the #3983 body. The body proposed a pre-tool chokepoint reading a non-forgeable memory source; the arc refuted that. The chokepoint already exists and already deposits; its matchers do not observe this host shell tool. A live session reproduced the hole: Write denied, identical write through run_terminal_command allowed, every commit and push ungated. #3614 analog: extract mutation targets from the payload and authorize each through inspectMutationGates, rather than widening a name list so every shell command inherits occupancy. Matching too broadly would deny occupancy:release (pinned in dispatcher.test.ts) and the Windows #2646 temp-file posting path. Out of scope: #3984 detector, host memory retention, amending #3961, closing #3984 or #3961.

items.title: Part 1: matcher coverage and reissue-path deny

narrative.Acceptance: A Write denied by occupancy is also denied when the same in-repo path is written through run_terminal_command (python pathlib or Set-Content). git status, occupancy:release, and an OS-temp pathlib write stay allowed. Deposited grok matchers include run_terminal_command, write, and search_replace. A host-catalog test fails closed when a known mutation tool is absent from the matcher set. The reissue-path test fails before the product change.

items.title: Part 2: in-flight elapsed on the existing ledger

narrative.Acceptance: evaluateInFlight blocks a running attempt whose wall-clock since startedAt meets maxElapsedSeconds with BLOCK_ELAPSED_BUDGET. A running attempt under budget is allowed. Pre-dispatch behavior is unchanged. No second budget store.

acceptance.derived_reason: operator envelope required a reissue-path test that fails before the change, plus in-flight elapsed on the existing ledger

clauses.text: A write denied through the edit tool cannot succeed by being reissued through the shell; proven by a test that fails before the change and exercises the reissue path.
Recognized in-repo shell write dests are authorized the same way Write is (occupancy/ritual/scope/fence). git status, occupancy:release, and OS-temp body-file writes are not occupancy-denied.
Deposited matchers and the runtime classifier cover Grok Build mutation spellings; a catalog test fails closed when a known mutation name is missing.
evaluateInFlight blocks a running attempt that has exhausted maxElapsedSeconds and allows one that has not.

intended_placement.cohesion_exemption: CHANGELOG.md is an append-only release log; this slice adds one Unreleased entry. dispatcher.ts already exceeds the review trigger; this slice adds one routing call for recognized shell write dests and keeps the classifier in a new shell-write-targets.ts file rather than growing the dispatcher.
